levels.text: Taking enemy damage empowers your next spell based on the mana you lost, up to a cap.

name: Arcane Feedback
notes: Casting the empowered spell consumes the bonus. Spell costs do not generate feedback. Damage scaling, the bonus cap and how multiple hits contribute are left for tuning.
